status: Exploratory challenge specified after reviewing existing published summaries and before running these new sensitivity outcomes; not an independent preregistration.
goal: Persistent goal 4: distinguish donor-level age associations from disease, covariate imbalance and fibroblast mixture before selecting tissue-repair readouts.
subgroup_policy: Exclude fibroblast/epithelial and lymphoid subgroups from aggregate counts; they overlap their combined parent and are not independent replication.
age_overlap_rule: Use the intersection of the healthy and disease age ranges in the full panel/cell-group donor set. Freeze those bounds before restrictions and omission checks; do not choose by expression outcomes.
female_age_overlap_rule: Restrict the frozen all-sex age-overlap range to female donors. This removes male extrapolation but further reduces donor support.

covariates.sex: male indicator relative to female, as supplied by the source metadata
covariates.version: Cell Ranger 3.0.1 indicator relative to 2.0.0; mixed versions are rejected

influence_rule: Omit exactly one inferred donor at a time from the full panel/cell-group dataset; retain failures and all individual donor results. No cell- or biopsy-level resampling.

fibroblast_mixture_challenge.score: For each gene, 0.5*CPM(Fibroblast 1)+0.5*CPM(Fibroblast 2), then mean log1p across the unchanged panel genes. Equal RNA weights are not equal cell fractions.
fibroblast_mixture_challenge.checks: Subgroup raw counts, cells and total UMIs must sum exactly to the combined fibroblast values; observed-mixture scores must reproduce the old combined scores within 1e-10.
fibroblast_mixture_challenge.model_policy: Compare observed and fixed-mixture scores using exactly the same donor sets and four full-cohort adjustment sets. No model is selected after seeing the results.

interpretation: All fitted coefficients and omission ranges are descriptive; no confirmatory p-values, age-in-years prediction, rejuvenation estimate or functional-regeneration claim.
Correlated panels and compartments share donors and are not independent studies.
Covariate adjustment and mixture standardization do not identify causal disease or aging effects.
Restricted common support may expose a lack of donors rather than resolve confounding.
